decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with its own page and close fit to the firm's core door business, it is likely to stay on the market while management waits for clearer performance signals.

Because it was only mentioned on the website and may serve a narrower niche, management would monitor it closely, but a large firm with some slack would usually give it more time before withdrawing it.
The remote-control variant is a plausible extension of the existing product line, so unless early results clearly fall below aspiration levels, the firm would likely continue offering it.

This product faces a somewhat higher withdrawal risk because it is less prominently presented and overlaps with related industrial door offerings, but the firm would still likely retain it for another year while assessing demand.

As a differentiated insulated industrial door for professional customers, it likely fits the firm's established capabilities and would usually be kept while early market acceptance is still uncertain.

Its own dedicated page signals stronger organisational commitment, and in a large German metal-products firm that usually means the product is given time to prove itself rather than being dropped quickly.
